cover_subtitle: Fix lighting, get data, automate expenses

slides.title: The problem
slides.body: → Photo taken under fluorescent light → glare obscured text → Claude returned empty result.

slides.title: First attempt
slides.body: → Prompted “extract table from image” → same empty output → assumed AI fault.

slides.title: The simple fix
slides.body: → Retake with phone flash → crop borders → run again → full line items appear.

slides.title: Automate the flow
slides.body: → CSV generated → import into Google Sheets → expense row created automatically.

slides.title: Next steps
slides.body: → Test crumpled receipts → add pre‑processing script → reduce crashes.

last_slide: Follow for weekly posts on building with AI from scratch.
